title: Add a slide of your own
subtitle: A new folder, then one line in presentation.json
bullets: A slide is a folder with a `content.json`, and one entry in `presentation.json`
Make the file first: a deck that lists a slide whose file is missing shows an error page that says so
task: Create the first file, with the text under it. Then add `"my-slide"` to a section's list in the second.
ask: In the tutorial deck, add a new content slide with the id my-slide, right after task-new-slide.
whenDone: Press O to see it among the others.
